artifact.description: Reproduction envelope for end-to-end verified polyhedral loop compilation

default_candidate.review_status: candidate; requires its own successful full offline review evidence before publication

dependency_lock_origin.purpose: reviewed source of the captured dependency state and immutable dependency base for v9 construction; not review evidence for the v9 candidate

reproducibility.source_snapshot: exact git tree exported with git archive
reproducibility.dependency_state_enforcement: build from the reviewed dependency origin image, then fail-closed verification after construction and again at offline review startup
reproducibility.dependency_lock_note: PolCert, Pluto, and the Pluto base registry digest are immutable pins. The dpkg and opam state was captured from the separately identified v2 full-reviewed dependency-lock origin image, whose exact local image ID seeds v9 construction. The v9 candidate verifies that state after build and at review startup; the v2 origin and v3 review evidence do not review the v9 wrapper. Rebuilding requires importing the authenticated origin image until an immutable registry publication is available.
